baseline.policy: Do not delete, modify, resume, or overwrite any baseline artifact or its environment.

miles.backend_approval: User approved Megatron and requested extensive infrastructure evidence
miles.container_storage: isolated fuse-overlayfs daemon, data in worker /tmp tmpfs; original Docker daemon unchanged
miles.checkpoint_numbering: zero-based rollout ID; 1 denotes the second optimizer update

required_invariants.initial_weights: original base-model checkpoint, not the trained step_2 checkpoint
required_invariants.advantages: reward minus group mean, without dividing by group standard deviation

compatibility_findings: Miles FSDP supports data parallelism but not the baseline expert parallelism. Megatron supports EP=8 but changes the trainer implementation and checkpoint format.
Miles uses SGLang, while the baseline used vLLM. Matching sampling knobs does not make sampled trajectories or kernel behavior bit-identical.

The standard Miles Verifiers adapter requires Verifiers 0.2.0 and an older EnvConfig/TrainClient API. The pinned baseline uses a newer API and OpenAI>=2.54.0. Preserve the pinned harness through an isolated adapter instead of downgrading or changing the baseline environment.

The baseline default IPO loss and mean-centered, unstandardized GRPO advantages must be ported and numerically tested. The stock Miles Qwen recipe changes both algorithm settings and optimizer settings.
The stock Miles Qwen3.6 recipe enables MTP/speculation. Both must stay disabled for this comparison.
The original task sample order, RNG state, and trajectory truncation/reduction semantics need verification before calling the workloads exact.

The baseline ran 120 episodes and accepted 32 traces; accepted step 1 tasks were task_14118 and task_10753, step 2 task_10753 and task_14118. The source cycles all four tasks and prunes zero-advantage groups.

Original Docker uses vfs. Initial Miles image pull exhausted local disks due to deep-copying each layer. Pulls were stopped, their temporary layers reclaimed by Docker, and staging switched to isolated fuse-overlayfs daemons. Record this as setup failure, not training time.

Megatron validates BF16 parameters but accumulates and all-reduces gradients in FP32, unlike baseline BF16 gradient reduction. Optimizer master/state precision and kernel/recompute behavior are backend differences.

The baseline sstat collector survives job 181 and appends errors to telemetry/slurm/sstat.out. Preservation checks found 188 of 189 inventoried artifact metadata entries unchanged and all 49 hashed source/config files unchanged; the sole changing file is this pre-existing monitor.
comparison_rules: Write all new results, logs, caches, model conversions, environments, and checkpoint files into separate directories.
Mount baseline model and task inputs read-only where possible; never mount baseline outputs as the new output directory.
Compare setup, inference startup, rollout, active optimizer work, weight transfer, checkpoint saving, and allocation lifetime separately.
Do not count the old allocation remaining open for roughly 3.5 hours after training finished as useful training time.
Report total completions, accepted samples, tokens, rewards, truncation, GPU utilization, memory, and per-stage timing alongside backend differences.
Treat a two-step run as a functionality and performance smoke test, not evidence of model-quality improvement.
Retain every attempt and inspect failures before retrying. Cancel only job-scoped processes and do not use global cleanup commands.
Job 190 is a warmed retry that reuses model conversion and filesystem/image caches. Do not present it as a cold-start speed comparison.

attempt_187.correction: Disable only prefill CUDA graph backend; retain decode graphs and all parallelism/workload settings.

gradient_reduction_dtype.reason: Megatron BF16 training validation requires FP32 gradient accumulation/reduction

prefill_cuda_graphs.reason: Pinned SGLang breakable prefill graph shape error in job187

schedule.baseline: asynchronous group prefetch and zero-advantage filtering
schedule.miles: synchronous two-step, cyclic same four tasks, zero-advantage filtering

inference_moe_kernel.reason: Pinned Miles Blackwell recipe documents identical weight-sync shape failure and selects this backend.

router_precision_kernel.reason: Pinned SGLang Qwen gate does not honor the baseline FP32 router-logit option.

request_routing.reason: Default cache-aware policy concentrated all observed workload requests on attention DP0.

attempt_188.correction: SGLang MoE runner flashinfer_cutlass, the backend selected by the pinned Miles Blackwell Qwen3.5 recipe; retain training dispatcher, parallelism and BF16.

attempt_189.correction: Reuse native admission iterator and FP32 surviving-group advantages, retain pre-cut credit for fixed batch 16.

required_invariants_interpretation: Baseline requested settings; explicit_backend_deviations identify settings not identically retained, especially FP32 versus BF16 gradient reduction.
